question: Where’s the closest museum forward of Memory Garden, Baltimore, MD in the direction of Cal, Sr.'s Yard, Aberdeen, MD?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), target_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cal, Sr.''s Yard%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Aberdeen%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), bearings AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM start_point) AS start_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM target_point) AS target_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM start_point), (SELECT geometry FROM target_point))) AS target_bearing_deg ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, bearings AS b WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, b.start_geom::geography, 100000) -- Search within 100km radius for performance AND ( -- Calculate the shortest angular difference between the museum's bearing from start_point -- and the target bearing, then check if it's within +/- 45 degrees. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(b.start_geom, p.geometry)) - b.target_bearing_deg), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(b.start_geom, p.geometry)) - b.target_bearing_deg) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, b.start_geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Lillie Carroll Jackson Civil Rights Museum
